method: Exactly two ordinary attempts at normal http://127.0.0.1:5173/ using visible-playtest browser-timed controls; paused synthetic play; own screenshots and visible UI only.
scale: 0–10: 0 unusable/absent, 5 functional but materially rough, 8 strong polished slice, 10 exemplary shipping standard. AAA readiness means observed readiness against a large commercial FPS presentation/usability bar, not project potential.
firstFriction: Forward movement stopped at low cover; vault corrected the west approach. Later east approach also needed correction. Distance markers alone did not tell me the receiver reach envelope.
strengths: Distinct rain-soaked cyan/amber art direction and strong title composition
Opening optic shot produced an understandable critical elimination
Paused facility map exposed walls, low cover, receivers and player position
Memory recovery clearly updated objective, card and supplies
limits: No win, jammer disable or extraction completed
Only short rifle combat and brief pump use; poor aim retained
No human enjoyment, audio or performance certification; software WebGL fallback
Synthetic pauses and long action batches affect pressure and timing; results are not human difficulty measurements
